answer.rationale: p99 latency spike confined to primary region within 90 minutes of recent release during peak settlement traffic. Regional failover has proven fastest recovery path (memory_b2: minutes to latency recovery, clean traffic shift). Verifying b1 to confirm rollback risk profile in case failover reveals the release is the root cause. Failover preserves writes by shifting to healthy region rather than risking data consistency with rollback during settlement peak. Read replica routing would not address write-path latency. Circuit breaker and capacity additions are slower remedies given the acute degradation and peak load window. Failover is reversible and maintains customer write continuity while investigation continues.
